entries.signature: aiditor.addPanelToDock({ dock, component, path?, title?, props?, transient? })
entries.summary: Add a registered or workspace-file component as a new panel in a runtime dock. If path is provided, the script is loaded before adding the panel.

params.name: input
params.description: Tool input.

params.name: input.dock
params.description: Dock id/name from inspectDocks.

params.name: input.component
params.description: Registered component id.

params.name: input.path
params.description: Optional workspace JS file to load before adding the panel.

params.name: input.title
params.description: Optional panel title.

params.name: input.props
params.description: Optional component props.

params.name: input.transient
params.description: Optional transient panel flag.

entries.summary: List current dock ids, names, viewport rects, panels, active panel, and accept rules so agents can choose a real runtime dock.

params.name: input
params.description: Tool input.

params.name: input.layout
params.description: Optional registered layout name; omit for all layouts.

entries.summary: Apply a literal or path inspector change to a schema-encoded value without mutating the original value.

params.name: value
params.description: Current top-level inspected value.

params.name: change
params.description: Change created by pathChange or literalChange.

params.name: schema
params.description: PropertyForm/Inspector schema used to preserve struct tuple, array, and dict encoding.

entries.summary: Create the bounded project/primary folding-state owner used by PropertyForm field Sections, recursive StructInput Sections, and Groups.

params.name: options
params.description: Optional persistence, LRU, and throttling configuration.

returns.description: FoldingStateStore with bind(scope,path), flush(), snapshot(workspaceId), and dispose().

entries.summary: Format string and numeric path segments into the inspector field path syntax.

params.name: segments
params.description: String field names and numeric array indices.

entries.summary: Create a whole-field replacement change for providers that intentionally replace a complete top-level field value.

params.name: field
params.description: Top-level schema field name.

params.name: value
params.description: Replacement value for that field.

entries.summary: Parse an inspector field path into string and numeric segments.

params.name: fieldPath
params.description: Path such as "items[2].transform.pos.x".

entries.summary: Create a leaf-level inspector change whose field is a dotted/bracketed schema path such as transform.pos.x or items[2].name.

params.name: fieldPath
params.description: Schema path. Field keys are path tokens; keys containing "." or "[]" are invalid schema usage.

params.name: value
params.description: Leaf replacement value.

entries.summary: Notify inspector panels to re-read the current selection after external state changes.
Register the editor-owned provider that turns selected targets of one type into an inspector schema, values, and write handlers.

params.name: type
params.description: Target type matched against target.type or target.kind.

params.name: provider
params.description: Provider with inspect(targets, ctx), plus optional accept(targets) and targetId(primary, targets) for stable per-primary UI state.

params.name: meta
params.description: Optional owner/layer metadata; pass { replace: true } only when intentionally replacing an existing provider.

entries.summary: Set the ordered inspector selection. The first target is primary; multi-edit uses only fields present and writable on every target.

params.name: targets
params.description: One target or ordered targets; each target should include type or kind.

params.name: meta
params.description: Optional selection metadata for the host/editor; workspaceId scopes persisted Inspector UI state.

entries.summary: Register a component that can be used as a panel, toolbar item, UI tree node, or palette item.

params.name: name
params.description: Unique component id.

params.name: spec
params.description: Component spec with factory(propsSig, ctx), plus optional defaults/dispose/serialize/deserialize/schema metadata.

params.name: meta
params.description: Optional owner/layer metadata, normally supplied by runtime.loadScript.

entries.summary: Reload one existing panel instance after its component file changes. Keeps the same panel id, dock position, title, props, and component.

params.name: input
params.description: Tool input.

params.name: input.panelId
params.description: Existing panel instance id returned by aiditor.inspectDocks.

params.name: input.path
params.description: Optional workspace JS file to load with replace semantics before rebuilding the panel.

params.name: input.component
params.description: Optional safety check; must match the current panel component. Use replacePanel to change component.

entries.signature: aiditor.replacePanel({ panelId, component, path?, title?, props?, transient?, discardDirty? })
entries.summary: Replace one existing panel instance with another component while keeping its dock position. Use reloadPanel after editing the same component file.

params.name: input
params.description: Tool input.

params.name: input.panelId
params.description: Existing panel instance id.

params.name: input.component
params.description: Registered component id.

params.name: input.path
params.description: Optional workspace JS file to load before replacing.

params.name: input.title
params.description: Optional panel title.

params.name: input.props
params.description: Optional component props.

params.name: input.discardDirty
params.description: Must be true to replace a dirty panel.

entries.signature: aiditor.runtime.loadScript({ id?, source?, url?, path?, owner?, layer?, type? })
entries.summary: Execute a workspace or host script with default owner/layer metadata so its registrations can be cleaned up as one contribution group.

params.name: input
params.description: Script loading options.

params.name: input.source
params.description: Inline JavaScript source text. Use source or url.

params.name: input.url
params.description: URL to fetch and execute. Use source or url.

params.name: input.path
params.description: Optional display/sourceURL path, commonly the workspace path.

params.name: input.owner
params.description: Owner attached to registrations made during execution.

params.name: input.layer
params.description: Registration layer, usually workspace, extension, or builtin.

entries.summary: Render a compact local action surface. Actions can run commands, call local UI handlers, or open framework menus.

params.name: opts
params.description: Action bar options.

params.name: opts.actions
params.description: UiAction records, a signal of records, or a function of ctx.

params.name: opts.ctx
params.description: Context passed to action predicates, args, menus, and commands.

params.name: opts.density
params.description: Optional density, "compact" by default.

entries.summary: Open a ui.menu from UiAction records at an anchor or pointer position.

params.name: opts
params.description: Menu options.

params.name: opts.anchor
params.description: Owner/anchor element for lifecycle and fallback placement.

params.name: opts.point
params.description: Optional pointer position: { x, y }.

params.name: opts.actions
params.description: UiAction records, a function of ctx, or Promise<UiAction[]>.

params.name: opts.ctx
params.description: Context passed to action predicates, args, menus, and commands.

params.name: opts.behavior
params.description: Optional menu behavior: "dropdown" (default) or "context".

params.name: opts.sourceScope
params.description: Optional error/log source scope for actions opened from another surface.

entries.summary: Create the format-neutral load/save state used by file-backed text editors. Workspace lookup, CAS writes, dirty state, external-change detection, and watcher cleanup live here; parsing stays in the editor.

params.name: options
params.description: Text document options.

params.name: options.workspaceId
params.description: Id registered through aiditor.workspace.bind.

params.name: options.path
params.description: Workspace-relative file path.

params.name: options.decode
params.description: Convert source text and file metadata into the editor model.

params.name: options.encode
params.description: Convert the editor model into source text.

params.name: options.equals
params.description: Optional model equality function; immutable models normally use identity.

returns.description: Document controller with signals and load, reload, save, set, checkExternal, snapshot, restore, and dispose methods.

entries.summary: Render a controlled spreadsheet-style grid with virtualized rows, range selection, cell editing, TSV clipboard, fill, column resize, and row/column reorder. The grid owns no domain model or persistence.

params.name: opts
params.description: Grid options.

params.name: opts.rows
params.description: Controlled row collection.

params.name: opts.columns
params.description: Controlled column definitions with optional id, name, width, align, and color.

params.name: opts.selection
params.description: Controlled selection with kind, anchor, and focus.

params.name: opts.getText
params.description: Return display/edit text for a row and column.

params.name: opts.onEdit
params.description: Commit one cell edit.

params.name: opts.onPaste
params.description: Commit a rectangular string matrix.

params.name: opts.onFill
params.description: Fill a target range from the source range.

entries.summary: Render a schema-driven property editor for one target or a multi-target batch edit. Multi-target reads use the first target value; writes fan out only through enabled fields.

params.name: opts
params.description: Form options.

params.name: opts.targets
params.description: Targets to edit.

params.name: opts.schema
params.description: Field schema passed to editorFor.

params.name: opts.onChange
params.description: Optional persistence hook: (fieldPath, newValue, targets, meta) => void.

params.name: opts.groups
params.description: Optional grouped section metadata, including labels, actions, defaultCollapsed, and enabledBy.

params.name: opts.groupActions
params.description: Optional per-group UiAction factory. Returning null/undefined falls back to groups[groupId].actions; returning [] explicitly clears actions.

params.name: opts.groupActionCtx
params.description: Optional mapper for the context passed to group actions.

params.name: opts.fieldActions
params.description: Optional per-field UiAction factory. Returning null/undefined falls back to schemaField.actions; returning [] explicitly clears actions.

params.name: opts.fieldContextActions
params.description: Optional field context-menu UiAction factory. May return UiAction[] or Promise<UiAction[]>.

params.name: opts.filePathActions
params.description: Optional UiAction factory appended to file path input menus.

params.name: opts.searchQuery
params.description: Optional display-only recursive field filter.

params.name: opts.foldingState
params.description: Optional Inspector FoldingStateStore shared by field Sections, recursive Structs, and Groups.

params.name: opts.foldingScope
params.description: Optional workspace/provider/primary identity consumed by foldingState.

params.name: opts.requireAllTargets
params.description: When true, disable fields missing from any target.

params.name: opts.canEdit
params.description: Optional field gate: (field, targets, rawField) => boolean.

entries.summary: Render a stable keyed list of expandable schema-driven property blocks.

params.name: opts
params.description: Property list options.

params.name: opts.items
params.description: Item array or signal. Refreshes reconcile by stable key.

params.name: opts.getKey
params.description: Stable item id resolver: (item, index) => id.

params.name: opts.schema
params.description: Schema resolver, object, or signal for each item body.

params.name: opts.onFieldChange
params.description: Optional field persistence hook: (itemId, field, value, meta) => void.

entries.summary: Bind a runtime workspace adapter to a JSON-safe id so PanelData stores identity rather than live adapter objects.

params.name: id
params.description: Stable host-owned workspace id.

params.name: adapter
params.description: Workspace adapter created by memory, fromHandle, fromBridge, or another contract-compatible host.

entries.summary: Configure the project-scoped JSON state adapter used for small UI/runtime state; this storage is separate from workspace files.

params.name: options
params.description: Adapter options.

params.name: options.adapter
params.description: Optional adapter with load(workspaceId,key), save(workspaceId,key,value), and remove(workspaceId,key).

entries.summary: Load one JSON-safe state value from an opaque project/workspace namespace.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Stable host-owned project/workspace identity.

params.name: key
params.description: State owner key.

entries.summary: Enqueue removal of one project-scoped state value through the same serialized write queue as save.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Stable host-owned project/workspace identity.

params.name: key
params.description: State owner key.

returns.description: Completion of this removal or a newer coalesced operation.

entries.summary: Enqueue a JSON-safe state write; writes for the same workspaceId and key are serialized and pending snapshots are coalesced to the newest value.

params.name: workspaceId
params.description: Stable host-owned project/workspace identity.

params.name: key
params.description: State owner key.

params.name: value
params.description: JSON-safe state value.

returns.description: Completion of this write or a newer coalesced write.
